# QR Code Generator

Version: 2.0.4

`qrcode.js` is the unmodified `package/dist/qrcode.js` from the published npm package `qrcode-generator@2.0.4`.

- [Upstream release](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator/releases/tag/js2.0.4)
- [Upstream license](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator/blob/js2.0.4/LICENSE), copied as `LICENSE.qrcode-generator`
- Package integrity `sha512-mZSiP6RnbHl4xL2Ap5HfkjLnmxfKcPWpWe/c+5XxCuetEenqmNFf1FH/ftXPCtFG5/TDobjsjz6sSNL0Sr8Z9g==`
- Script integrity `sha256-eeyG+ChWAFsciHkFz8z8++w4Icphx/1alS+qX3ePeRw=`

The handoff dialog loads the local script on demand and checks its integrity before drawing the QR code. The script byte sequence is preserved in Git for reproducible integrity checks on all platforms.
